Erica: Quick post-all-hands thread 1 infra + capacity clarifications only. Keep replies short.
Sam: Short summary: hosted GPU pool healthy for Q2; APAC spot variance may affect cutover dates for new endpoints. We'll bias reserved capacity in EU while APAC stabilizes.
Noah: Any change to Dedicated on-call for capacity bumps during launches? We had confusion last quarter.
Vikram: New process: capacity-ops owns the reservation plan; oncall executes. We'll add a pre-launch checklist to the repo and a single Slack shortcut to request an emergency bump.
Lina: Can we get the exact failover TTL and how it's exposed to customers? Want to update playbooks.
Sam: Config: soft_fail_ttl_ms=2000, hard_fail_ms=5000. Console shows a "served_from" field and an event when cross-region serving occurs. We'll add a webhook option.
Erica: Autoscaler question from infra: what's the plan for noisy small spikes?
Vikram: Implementing a burst token buffer (30s) + adaptive cooldown. Scale-down windows will be 5m, 10m, 20m. This reduces churn for pipelines with bursty traffic.
Noah: Any telemetry hooks so SRE dashboards can show rollback/quantization fallbacks?
Sam: Yes: per-request metadata includes model_variant, region, fallback_reason. Dashboards will have a "fallback rate" panel by route.
Lina: Does fallback to quantized models change response shapes or need client handling?
Vikram: No shape changes; only slightly different logits. We document equivalence caveats in the model catalog.
ops-bot: :information_source: Autoscaler experiment deployed to staging (exp-id: as-21). Logs: https://logs.internal/as-21
Sam: Procurement note: A100 reorder ETA ~8 weeks; H100 gating is kernel validation (Q3 target). We're negotiating committed pools with two providers to reduce APAC spot risk.
Erica: Action items: sam/procurement note -> post in #eng-ops; vikram/open autoscaler PR + sim results; lina/update runbook with failover TTL and operations shortcut; noah/coordinate pre-launch checklist for Dedicated customers. We'll reconvene in #all-hands next week.
Sam: I'll file the items today and tag owners. Thanks! :pray:
